messages:
marta: Proposal: tenant-level 'auto_rollforward' in Console. Modes: off / drift (small probes) / failover (use fallback if primary saturated). Need quick alignment on billing, quotas, telemetry, and sensible defaults. Thoughts?

lin: Important: billing must reflect the model that served. If a probe lands on older model, tokens and costs should attribute to that model in exports. Otherwise refunds + disputes explode.

owen: Agreed. Also add a `served_model` column in billing CSV and a `probe=true` flag. That gives customers and finance deterministic reconciliation.

frank: Sampling note: do NOT random sample per-request. Use deterministic cohort sampling keyed by tenant_id+session_id to preserve KV cache locality. Keep cohorts sticky for e.g. 20 minutes.

marta: Draft config idea:

```
auto_rollforward:
  enabled: true
  mode: drift      # drift | failover
  probe_percent: 4
  sampling_key: hash(tenant_id || session_id)
  sticky_minutes: 20
  trace_pct: 0.5
```

lin: Telemetry checklist: counter `rollforward.probes_total{tenant,cohort}`, gauge `rollforward.active_cohorts`, per-model latency histograms split by `probe=true/false`, and a counter `rollforward.quota_blocked{tenant}` when a probe would exceed fallback quota.

owen: Console UX: before enabling show "Projected cost delta" computed from last 30 days token mix x model rates + confidence band. If projection variance > threshold show a modal warning.

frank: Safety: if routing to fallback would consume reserved quota the tenant has on that model, block failover mode and allow only drift probes. Also, if probe rate would risk hitting concurrency or rate-limits on fallback, we need server-side pre-checks and soft-throttles. Emit `rollforward.throttled` metric.

marta: Security: internal-only header `x-rwd-rollprobe` to mark probes. Strip at edge. Persist cohort ids in audit logs but redact in customer-facing telemetry. Encrypt those logs.

deploy-bot: infra-bot: feature-flag created in staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4410 - canary tomorrow. :rocket:

lin: Trace sampling: allow per-tenant override `trace_pct`. Default should be conservative: `trace_pct = min(0.5%, probe_percent)`. Also annotate spans with `rollforward.cohort`.

owen: UX copy draft: "Enable measured roll-forward: small, sticky samples of traffic may be routed to an older compatible model during congestion. We show estimated cost impact and any quota conflicts before you enable." Keep modal brief.

frank: Implementation notes: sticky cohort assignment must be stable across frontends and proxies (use HMAC with infra salt). Make sure salt rotation strategy accounts for cohort churn.

marta: Action items: (1) Console mock + modal copy (marta), (2) billing + export labels (owen), (3) sampling alg + sticky HMAC (frank), (4) telemetry + dashboards (lin). I'll draft an RFC and link PRs after canary.

marta: Thanks team :thumbsup:
